subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands use explicit per-account nativeNames mapping, constrained nativePrefix sugar, or remain unsupported for duplicate Slack native command names?
rationale: Current main has no account-level naming contract, the prior PRs show a real design fork, and either implementation expands Slack account config surface.

options.title: Implement validated nativeNames
options.body: Add explicit per-account command-name mapping with strict Slack-name validation, duplicate checks, registration, reverse lookup, docs, and tests.

options.title: Implement constrained nativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar with narrow slug validation and no broad dash-stripping fallback, accepting a simpler UX but another naming abstraction.

options.title: Document unsupported duplicates
options.body: Keep runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register the same native slash command names.

recommendation.title: Implement validated nativeNames
recommendation.body: Add explicit per-account command-name mapping with strict Slack-name validation, duplicate checks, registration, reverse lookup, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current and historical signal on the shared native command registry and Slack native alias behavior this decision would change.
